text.en: This Act may be cited as the Arms and Explosives Act.

The provisions of this Act and of any rules made thereunder apply to such arms and explosives as may be declared and defined by His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, by notification published in the Gazette.

Without prejudice to the jurisdiction of the High Court, a Court of a Magistrate shall have jurisdiction to try any offence against this Act and to impose any penalty prescribed therefor not exceeding 7 years imprisonment and a fine of $10,000.
